references.text: The tribe of Simeon is also mentioned here in connection with the census in the wilderness, where the leader of the tribe is presented.
Another leader from the tribe of Simeon, Zephath son of Hor, was sent as a spy to Canaan.
The tribe of Simeon received its inheritance within the territory of Judah, fulfilling the planned distribution of the land.
The context for the appointment of tribal leaders who were to distribute the land, including Caleb and Shemuel.
Jacob's prophecy about Simeon explains why the tribe was later scattered in Israel and received its inheritance within Judah.
